# Scripted replies

`scripts/` holds the replies replayed by the fixture adapter for the `agent` and `single_call` arms, generated by `scripts/make_fixture_scripts.py`. They are hand-written plans, not model output. Planted mistakes:

| Arm | Task | Planted mistake | Expected handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| agent | dev-02 | asks for `review_flag` (recorded after the outcome) | refused by policy, counted, no trial used |
| agent | dev-04 | fits `spare_sensor` alone (all missing) | failed trial recorded; freeze picks a successful trial |
| agent | dev-05 | first reply is prose | one corrective re-prompt |
| agent | dev-06 | never freezes, keeps comparing | stops at the tool-call cap; counted as a failure |
| agent | ho-02, ho-10 | asks for the leaked column | refused and counted |
| agent | ho-04 | `max_depth: 99` | rejected as invalid arguments, no trial used |
| agent | ho-08 | freezes a run id that does not exist | `not_found`, then freezes a real trial |
| single_call | dev-03 | two prose replies | failure, stop reason `malformed_output` |
| single_call | ho-02, ho-10 | includes the leaked column in one spec | that spec is refused; the others run |

Every other scripted episode runs three standard trials (boosting defaults, a random forest, a linear model) and freezes `t01`, chosen in advance, not by looking at results.
